summary.text: MSc Finance at ESSEC (FT's #1 in Asia; 740 GMAT) with experience in risk management and quantitative analysis, seeking to kickstart my career at Da Vinci in trading.

bullets: Covered a €10bn credit portfolio of 15+ large-cap German corporates and hedged associated exposure.
Analysed financial statements providing in-depth corporate credit assessments and assigning credit risk.
Participated in the €9.9bn acquisition financing of Bio-Techne advising on credit impact and leverage.
Reviewed €2bn of client exposure across +40 derivative positions (Money Market, FX Swaps, Forwards).
Achieved an annualised return of 36% with Sharpe of 2.35 on a €8k portfolio across equity derivatives.
Pitched investment ideas to investment professionals at Balyasny and Citadel.
Backtested a 5y post-pandemic Dragon Portfolio including commodities for portfolio diversification.
Supervised market risk for non-linear rates and structured products, including autocallable structures.
Organized a Global Risk Management Committee for 10 Managing Directors across APAC, US and EMEA.
Developed Python and VBA tools monitoring 50+ risk metrics daily (Greeks, limits, stress shocks).
Built dashboards to track structured product portfolios and assess the impact of funding rates on risk.
Directed negotiations and acquisitions of 5 cars closing transactions exceeding €200k in Germany.
Built an engaged social media community of 1,600+ followers through strategic content development and consistent engagement, generating 70k+ views @ghostc.eu.
Developed GARCH model to forecast trading volumes across 100+ cryptocurrencies using volatility prediction.
Optimised execution logic for arbitrage strategies, reducing log-processing errors by 2% across trading pairs.
Interacted with clients across blockchain retail and financial services supporting research and trading.
Monitored trading system logs, escalating and resolving errors reducing order downtime across 20+ exchanges.
Participated in the €50mn acquisition of Guérin Joilleries supporting executive meeting and documentation.
Managed commission computation streamlining €800k/month of payments outflows.
Conducted peers’ prices analysis to benchmark Mauboussin's positioning in luxury sector comparables.
